$comment: Directory of hosted three.ws Model Context Protocol servers. Every endpoint speaks MCP over Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0, POST). Dozens more install-and-run servers are published on npm under the @three-ws scope; find all of them in the official MCP registry.
name: three.ws
description: The 3D agent economy: generate, rig, and animate 3D avatars and worlds; pay and get paid per call with x402 (USDC on Solana and Base); read live crypto market and on-chain intelligence.

setup.description: One command signs you in (OAuth or API key), writes these servers into Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Hermes, and verifies each with a live tools/list.

clients.$comment: three.ws extension, not part of any MCP spec: per-client setup hints so an agent can connect without a human. Consumers must ignore unknown fields. Each recommendedServer is an endpoint listed in servers[].

settings.where: Settings, Apps and Connectors, Advanced settings (turn on Developer mode), then Create
mcp.json or the Add to Cursor button on the connect page
.vscode/mcp.json or the Add to VS Code button on the connect page

authUpgrade.adds: the account's agent, memory, skill and avatar tools; never a wallet or payment tool

settings.where: Connectors, add a custom MCP connector
settings.note: The URL must be public: Grok Bot connects from xAI's cloud, so a localhost URL never works.

authUpgrade.adds: the account's agents, memory, wallets and x402 tools, through Bob's built-in OAuth on first connect

settings.where: .bob/mcp.json in the project, or ~/.bob/settings/mcp.json for every workspace (Bob panel, MCP tab, Edit Project MCP or Edit Global MCP)
settings.note: Bob Shell reads the same files but names the URL key httpURL.

servers.name: three.ws
servers.auth: OAuth 2.1 (end-user), API key (server-to-server), or x402 pay-per-call
servers.description: Avatars, glTF/GLB validation and inspection, agent data, memory, and copy-trading tools.

servers.name: 3D Studio
servers.description: Paid text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation, rigging, retexture, and optimization.

servers.name: 3D Studio (free)
servers.description: Free text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigged avatars, persistent talking personas, and a search of the ready-made asset catalog. No account, no payment.

servers.name: Grok
servers.auth: none for the free 3D tools; OAuth 2.1 or a connector API key adds the account's agent tools
servers.description: One connector URL for Grok Bot and the xAI API: the free 3D studio with agent-ready links and no widgets, plus your agents, their memory and skills once signed in. Never lists a wallet or payment tool.

servers.name: Agent wallet
servers.description: The agent's custodial wallet: check balance, find and pay x402 services, monetize an endpoint.

servers.name: x402 Bazaar
servers.description: Discover, browse, and price paid agent services across the x402 facilitator network.

servers.name: pump.fun
servers.auth: none for the read-only tools; API key or x402 for pumpfun_upload_metadata
servers.description: Free pump.fun and Solana token tools: holders, trades, curve, intel. One write: metadata upload.

servers.name: IBM x402
servers.auth: x402 pay-per-call (authenticated three.ws principals call without per-call payment)
